Plumper lips with zero burn - that's the promise of the Lakmē 9to5 HyaGloss Power Plump Lip Oil, a plumping lip oil built for the glass-lip trend. Most plumping glosses trade comfort for results, leaving lips tingling and irritated; this Lakmē HyaGloss formula doesn't, delivering visibly fuller, glossy lips from the very first swipe, without a hint of the sting other plumpers are known for.

How It Works

The formula works through ingredients that support your lips, not fight them. Peppermint Oil creates a refreshing, tingly plump effect, giving that icy-cool sensation without the harsh sting of chilli or capsaicin-based plumpers. Hyaluronic Acid draws in and locks moisture into the lip surface for a visibly fuller, hydrated pout, while Vitamin E softens and nourishes for a smooth, healthy-looking finish. Together, these work into a lightweight, non-sticky texture that glides on effortlessly, like a true lip gloss oil, and dries down to a glazed, glass-like shine, with a fresh watermelon scent adding a calming touch to every swipe.

Suited to You

 Designed for real, everyday wear rather than just special occasions, the ergonomic applicator features a curved, cushiony tip that hugs the natural contour of your lips, with a carved groove that scoops the perfect amount for one smooth, precise application every time. As a hydrating lip oil that also works as a lip oil for everyday dullness, the buildable tint sheers out for a subtle flush or builds up for a statement finish, suiting most lip tones and skin tones alike. Wear it alone as a tinted lip gloss for a flattering my-lips-but-better look, or layer it over a shade from the 9to5 Forever Matte Lip Crayon for extra dimension, whether you're headed into a meeting, out for college, or straight to evening plans.

The Lakmē Edge

Available across 7 shades, from everyday nudes like Clear Goals and Vacation Nude to bold statement tints like Bosslady Brick and Powersuit Pink, this lip oil, also known as the Lakmē Powerplump Lip Oil, moves with you from college-ready mornings to festive-ready nights. 1. Uncap and glide the curved, cushiony tip along your lips, starting at the centre and moving outward.
2. Build up gradually for a bolder, high-shine finish.
3. Reapply through the day to refresh the plumped, glazed glow.

1. Does lip plumping oil actually work?

Yes, when it's formulated with ingredients that genuinely support the lips. Hyaluronic Acid is known to draw in moisture, while Peppermint Oil adds a tingly sensation that reads as plumped. Together, they create a real, visible difference without needles or fillers.

2. Is plumping lip oil safe?

Generally, yes, when the plumping comes from gentle ingredients rather than harsh irritants. This formula uses Peppermint Oil for a cooling tingle instead of chilli or capsaicin, so lips feel soothed rather than stung. As with any new lip product, a patch test is a good first step if you have known sensitivities.

3. Can lip plumper fix thin lips?

Lip plumpers don't permanently change lip structure, but they can visibly enhance fullness for as long as you wear them. This product hydrates and swells the lip surface slightly, while a glossy finish reflects light to make lips appear fuller. It's a temporary, buildable effect, not a fix.

4. How long do lip plumpers last?

The plumped, glazed look typically lasts a few hours before it needs a top-up. Reapplying through the day refreshes both the shine and the tingly plump sensation. Keeping it in your bag for touch-ups after meals or drinks helps maintain the effect for longer.

5. How do I know if my lip plumper is working?

You'll usually notice a subtle tingling or cooling sensation on application, followed by lips that look fuller and feel hydrated rather than tight or dry. In a 2026 consumer study, 100% of users agreed this formula gave them plumper, glossy, hydrated lips.*

6. How to use Lakmē Power Plump Lip Oil correctly?

Glide the curved, cushiony applicator tip along your lips, starting at the centre and moving outward, then build up gradually for more shine and plump. Reapply through the day as needed, and layer over a matte lipstick if you want added dimension.

7. How many times should I apply lip plumper?

There's no fixed number; it depends on how much shine and plump you want. One swipe gives a natural, buildable tint, while reapplying through the day tops up both hydration and the tingly plumping sensation as it wears off.

8. Do your lips go back to normal after lip plumper?

Yes, the plumping effect is temporary and fades gradually as the product wears off through the day. There's no lasting change to lip volume once you stop reapplying, which is why many people keep a lip oil handy for regular touch-ups.

9. How do you wear the lip plumper?

Wear it alone for a natural, my-lips-but-better glow, or layer it over a matte lipstick, such as the 9to5 Forever Matte Lip Crayon, for a glossy topper that adds shine and dimension.

10. Can lip plumper permanently plump lips?

No, lip plumpers like this one don't create permanent change; the effect lasts only as long as the product sits on your lips. For a temporary, needle-free way to look fuller day to day, that's exactly what a hydrating, tingly formula like this is designed for.

products.title: Lakmē Be-Jewel Shimmer Lip Liquid
products.body_html:
"Introducing the Lakmē Be-jewel Shimmer Lip Liquid — where matte meets multidimensional radiance. Inspired by the subtle glow of precious gems, this innovative lip formula brings together the sophistication of a soft matte with the brilliance of a refined shimmer finish. The luxurious liquid-to-matte texture glides on like velvet, then transforms as it sets — unveiling a diffused, luminous sheen. Featherlight yet intensely pigmented, the formula offers up to 14 hours of waterproof, transfer-proof, and smudge-resistant wear. Designed to flatter all skin tones, each of the five wearable nude-toned shades deliver understated glamour with a multidimensional twist — proving that subtle can still shine. Whether worn as a soft shimmer or layered for full-impact glow, Lakmē Shimmer Lip Liquid offers the perfect balance of matte structure and jewel-inspired luminosity. Pair it with the rest of the Bejewel collection to elevate your glam — because with lips this radiant, the spotlight follows you."

Step 1: Apply one stroke of liquid lip over your lips and allow some time for colot to set to a luminous matte finish.
Step 2: For an even more glamorous payoff, tap your lips with your fingers to reveal a saturated shimmer look.

products.title: Lakmē Be-jewel Satin Eye Tint
products.body_html:
"Unleash jewel-inspired luminosity with the Lakmē Be-jewel Satin Eye Tint — a luxurious, one-step liquid eyeshadow crafted for brilliance. Inspired by the captivating gleam of fine gemstones, this innovative formula delivers a smooth, satin-like shimmer that mimics the multifaceted glow of cut jewels. Intense colour meets all-day precision with the Lakmē 9to5 Eyeconic Liquid Eyeliner. This liquid eyeliner is built with a unique flexi-tip brush that glides on like liquid and sets in one easy stroke, giving you complete control whether you are drawing a thin everyday line or a bold, dramatic wing. Many shoppers compare eyeliner price against how long it actually lasts through the day, and at Rs. 276, this one is built to earn its keep well past a single wear.

What Makes a Waterproof Eyeliner Truly Smudge-Proof?

A genuinely waterproof eyeliner needs to resist more than just water; it has to hold up against sweat, humidity, oily lids and the general wear and tear of a long day without fading, feathering or transferring. This liner is built for exactly that, with a smudge-proof, waterproof and transfer-proof formula designed to survive humid commutes and late evenings alike, holding its line for up to 24 hours without needing a single touch-up.

What Should You Look for in an Eyeliner for Sharp, Winged Lines?

 Getting a clean, symmetrical wing usually comes down to the applicator, since a tip that is too stiff or too flexible makes it hard to control the flick. This liquid eyeliner uses a flexi-tip brush designed to adapt to both a thin, everyday line and a bold, winged eyeliner look, paying off intense, true black pigment in a single sweep so there's no need to go over the line twice and risk a shaky hand.

Is Liquid Eyeliner Safe for Everyday Wear and Sensitive Eyes?

Since eyeliner sits so close to the eye, a formula meant for daily wear should ideally be tested for the eye area and safe for contact lens wearers, not just long-lasting. This eyeliner is ophthalmologically tested and suitable for sensitive eyes and contact lenses, with a lightweight, fast-setting texture that locks onto the lash line in seconds. 1. Is liquid liner better than gel?

Neither is universally better, since it comes down to the finish you want. Liquid formulas tend to give richer pigment and a crisper, more precise line in one stroke, like this flexi-tip liner, while gel liners are often easier to smudge out for a softer, smokier look

2. What is liquid eyeliner used for?

Liquid eyeliner is used to define the lash line with a precise, high-pigment finish, from a thin everyday line to a bold winged look. This liner's flexi-tip brush is built for exactly that range, adapting to both subtle definition and a dramatic, statement wing.

3. Is kajal better or eyeliner?

Neither replaces the other, since they serve different purposes. Kajal gives a softer, smudged, kohl-like definition and works well along the waterline, while liquid eyeliner gives a crisp, precise line, best suited for winged looks, and the two are often used together for a complete eye look.

4. What is the best way to apply liquid eyeliner?

Rest your elbow on a steady surface, then sweep the tip along your lash line from the inner corner outward for a clean, confident line. With this liner, flick the brush upward and outward at the outer corner to build your wing, and let it set for a few seconds without blinking.

5. Is liquid eyeliner better for beginners?

It depends on the applicator more than the format itself, since a stiff, unforgiving tip is what usually trips up first-timers. A flexible tip like the one on this liner gives more control over both straight lines and curved wings, making it easier to build confidence early on.

6. What are some common liquid eyeliner mistakes?

The most common mistakes are loading too much product onto the brush, applying with an unsteady hand, and blinking before the formula sets, all of which can cause smudging or an uneven line. This liner's fast-setting, single-stroke pigment payoff helps reduce the risk of most of these.

7. How long to use liquid eyeliner?

Most liquid eyeliners are best used within a few months of opening, since the eye area calls for extra hygiene care. This one has a shelf life of 24 months from manufacture, so it's worth noting the date you first open it and replacing it if the formula changes in texture or smell.

8. How to use eyeliner for the first time?

Start with short, light strokes from the inner corner outward rather than attempting a full wing right away, building confidence as you go. This liner's flexi-tip brush and intense, single-sweep pigment payoff make it easier to practise without needing to go over the line repeatedly.

9. Can I use eyeliner every day?

Yes, daily wear is generally fine, especially with a formula tested for the eye area. This liner is ophthalmologically tested and suitable for sensitive eyes and contact lens wearers, so it's designed with everyday use around the eyes in mind rather than just occasional wear.

10. Does Lakmē Eyeconic liquid eyeliner last all day?

Yes, it's formulated to last up to 24 hours without smudging, feathering or fading. Its smudge-proof, waterproof and transfer-proof formula is built to hold through long workdays, humidity and evening plans alike, so it stays put from your morning commute to a late night out.
